answer: A sybil farm must pay a real admission proof-of-work per identity, then at every epoch pulse each head must author a fresh semantic answer whose seeded words rotate unpredictably. Peers echo-check uniqueness and grade coherence before attesting, so one clone cannot be replayed across a thousand members. On the knoll of each checkpoint, graders audit settled verdicts, and any cluster found planting junk loses its stake and its grove of cheap seats.
